name: revit-workbench
description: Setup and migration playbooks for Autodesk Revit over MCP: a one-step installer that puts the Horizun and BIMwright Revit MCP servers on a Windows workstation from an offline kit and registers them in Claude Code and Claude Desktop, plus a step-by-step procedure for rebuilding AutoCAD (DWG) drawings of architecture, concrete, steel and HVAC as a Revit model.
